q: Are study design, clinical setting and cohort details sufficient?
hint: Design, sites, dates, eligibility, data provenance.

q: Are data partitions, preprocessing and labelling described?
hint: Splits, transforms, annotation protocol and quality control.

q: Is the model (architecture, training, tuning, baseline) described?
Is evaluation sound (metrics, uncertainty, external check)?
hint: Appropriate metrics, CIs, held-out or external test.

q: Are code, environment and data access stated (minimum information)?
hint: Repository, dependencies, access procedure or reason if closed.

q: Are limitations, bias risks and intended-use limits stated?
hint: Failure modes, subgroup gaps, no overclaiming.
